key: MCKREZZY: Once we board, we run aground~
en: MCKREZZY: Once we board, we run aground~
ja: マクレジー: 乗り込めば、座礁する〜

key: A Flame Wheel of Fortune is all abound~
en: A Flame Wheel of Fortune is all abound~
ja: フレイムホイール・オブ・フォーチュン、あたり一面に広がる〜

key: Turning, yet burning-- unspoken sound~
en: Turning, yet burning-- unspoken sound~
ja: 回り、燃え――語られぬ響き〜

key: As fate ever moves us around and round~
en: As fate ever moves us around and round~
ja: 運命は絶えず、我らをぐるぐると巡らせる〜

key: Flame Wheel of Fortune-- from my latest album.
en: Flame Wheel of Fortune-- from my latest album.
ja: フレイムホイール・オブ・フォーチュン――私の最新アルバムからだ。

key: I assume you know it.
en: I assume you know it.
ja: 君も知っていると思うが。

key: It only seemed fitting here, even if we aren't in the Burning car.
en: It only seemed fitting here, even if we aren't in the Burning car.
ja: バーニングカーではないにせよ、ここにはふさわしい選曲だと思ってね。

key: Probably for the best; I can't imagine that one passing safety regulations.
en: Probably for the best; I can't imagine that one passing safety regulations.
ja: むしろその方がいいだろう、あの車両が安全基準を通るとは到底思えないからな。

key: It seemed only fitting, given the field we've been rolled.
en: It seemed only fitting, given the field we've been rolled.
ja: 割り当てられたこのフィールドを考えれば、ふさわしいと言えるだろう。

key: Well, shall we begin?
en: Well, shall we begin?
ja: さて、始めようか?

key: We've a date with destiny-- though I fear there won't be a second one.
en: We've a date with destiny-- though I fear there won't be a second one.
ja: 運命との約束だ――もっとも、二度目はなさそうだがね。

key: Meloetta will be the perfect accompaniment for my next single!
en: Meloetta will be the perfect accompaniment for my next single!
ja: メロエッタは私の次のシングルに、この上ない伴奏になってくれるだろう!

key: I can't allow anyone to stand in the way of my career. Therefore, you must prepare yourself!
en: I can't allow anyone to stand in the way of my career. Therefore, you must prepare yourself!
ja: 自分のキャリアの邪魔を、誰であろうと許すわけにはいかない。だから、覚悟してもらおう!

key: Ah, it seems I struck a flat chord...
en: Ah, it seems I struck a flat chord...
ja: ああ、どうやら音を外してしまったようだ……

key: MCKREZZY: ...I see.
en: MCKREZZY: ...I see.
ja: マクレジー: ……そういうことか。

key: Just as well!
en: Just as well!
ja: それならそれで構わない!

key: If this is what fate has decided, it simply means that my duet with Meloetta was not meant to be!
en: If this is what fate has decided, it simply means that my duet with Meloetta was not meant to be!
ja: これが運命の決めたことなら、メロエッタとのデュエットは、そもそも縁がなかったというだけのこと!

key: I shall rise above her and create a single solely on my own talent as I always have!
en: I shall rise above her and create a single solely on my own talent as I always have!
ja: いつも通り、自分自身の才能だけで彼女を超えるシングルを作り上げてみせよう!

key: I hope you will still consider picking it up when it eventually hits stores. Until then!
en: I hope you will still consider picking it up when it eventually hits stores. Until then!
ja: いずれ店頭に並んだときには、ぜひ手に取ってもらえるとうれしい。それでは、また!

key: JULIA: Oh? You're approaching me?
en: JULIA: Oh? You're approaching me?
ja: ジュリア: あら? 近づいてくるの?

key: Instead of running away like you should, you're actually coming closer?
en: Instead of running away like you should, you're actually coming closer?
ja: 逃げるのが普通なのに、わざわざこっちに近づいてくるなんて?

key: ...Nevermind that you're already in the gondola and not moving.
en: ...Nevermind that you're already in the gondola and not moving.
ja: ……あなたがもうゴンドラの中にいて、動いてすらいないことは、置いといて。

key: I was dramatically holding my eyes closed in this pose for so long that I didn't notice at first.
en: I was dramatically holding my eyes closed in this pose for so long that I didn't notice at first.
ja: このポーズで目を閉じたまま長々と決めてたから、最初は気づかなかったわ。

key: Nevermind that-- our long-awaited rematch is finally upon us!
en: Nevermind that-- our long-awaited rematch is finally upon us!
ja: そんなことより――待ちに待ったリベンジマッチの時が、ついに来たわね!

key: When we're done with this battle, there will be nothing left of this Battle Wheel standing!
en: When we're done with this battle, there will be nothing left of this Battle Wheel standing!
ja: このバトルが終わる頃には、このバトルホイールは跡形もなくなってるでしょうね!

key: Ka-ba-ba-ba-BOOM!!!
en: Ka-ba-ba-ba-BOOM!!!
ja: カ・バ・バ・バ・ドカーン!!!

key: Wait, the structure is still intact! We can't be done yet!?
en: Wait, the structure is still intact! We can't be done yet!?
ja: えっ、建物まだ無事じゃん! これで終わりなワケないよねっ!?

key: JULIA: So that's it, then...
en: JULIA: So that's it, then...
ja: ジュリア: そう、これで終わりなのね……

key: Boo...
en: Boo...
ja: ぶーぶー……

key: If there's no secondary explosion and total structural collapse, what even is the point...?
en: If there's no secondary explosion and total structural collapse, what even is the point...?
ja: 二次爆発と完全崩壊がないなら、いったい何の意味があるのよ……?

key: Well, nighty nite!
en: Well, nighty nite!
ja: じゃ、おやすみなさい!

key: ZzzzZZZzzz...
en: ZzzzZZZzzz...
ja: ズズズーッ……

key: zzzZZZzzzZZZzzz...
en: zzzZZZzzzZZZzzz...
ja: ズズズズズーーッ……

key: ZZZZZzzzzZZZZzzzzZZZZZzzzz...
en: ZZZZZzzzzZZZZzzzzZZZZZzzzz...
ja: ズズズズズズズズーーーッ……

key: BRELOOM: BrEE~
en: BRELOOM: BrEE~
ja: キノガッサ: ブリー〜

key: LOOOOOOO--
en: LOOOOOOO--
ja: ロォォォォォォ――

key: Zzzzzzzzttt--
en: Zzzzzzzzttt--
ja: クラリス: ズザザザザッ――

key: BRELOOM: BreeLL--
en: BRELOOM: BreeLL--
ja: キノガッサ: ブリール――

key: OetTA...
en: OetTA...
ja: オエッタ……

key: BrELoEtTA...
en: BrELoEtTA...
ja: ブレロエッタ……

key: RINGMASTER: Hi, \PN!
en: RINGMASTER: Hi, \PN!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: あら、\PN!

key: It turns out the Mystery Participant was me all along!
en: It turns out the Mystery Participant was me all along!
ja: 実は「なぞの参加者」って、ずっとあたしのことだったの!

key: Are you surprised?!
en: Are you surprised?!
ja: びっくりした!?

key: RINGMASTER: Yes, gottem!
en: RINGMASTER: Yes, gottem!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: よし、引っかかったわね!

key: ...Unless you were just being nice.
en: ...Unless you were just being nice.
ja: ……ただの優しさで驚いたふりをしてるんじゃなければ、だけど。

key: In which case that's not very nice.
en: In which case that's not very nice.
ja: だとしたら、それはそれで優しくないわね。

key: RINGMASTER: Yeah, I'm... not very good at this whole secret identity thing.
en: RINGMASTER: Yeah, I'm... not very good at this whole secret identity thing.
ja: サーカスだんちょう: まあ、あたしって……秘密の正体を隠すの、あんまり得意じゃないのよね。

key: I didn't think everyone was just going to clear out of here entirely as soon as they lost,
en: I didn't think everyone was just going to clear out of here entirely as soon as they lost,
ja: 負けた人がみんな、あっさりここから消えちゃうとは思わなかったわ、

key: Like losing breaks some kind of spell on them!
en: Like losing breaks some kind of spell on them!
ja: まるで、負けた瞬間に魔法が解けるみたいに!

key: I thought there would at least be a crowd or numbers to hide in or something, but...
en: I thought there would at least be a crowd or numbers to hide in or something, but...
ja: せめて人混みに紛れて隠れるくらいはできると思ってたのに……

key: No matter!
en: No matter!
ja: まあ、どうでもいいわ!

key: I said I would host a tournament for it, but I've no need to give Meloetta up if I also win that tournament!
en: I said I would host a tournament for it, but I've no need to give Meloetta up if I also win that tournament!
ja: トーナメントを開催するとは言ったけど、あたし自身がその大会に優勝すれば、メロエッタを手放す必要なんてないもの!

key: So all I have to do is simply beat you, the entire Champion!
en: So all I have to do is simply beat you, the entire Champion!
ja: つまり、あたしがやるべきことは、チャンピオンさん、あなたを倒すことだけ!

key: Let's have at it!
en: Let's have at it!
ja: さあ、やりましょう!

key: I should never have waived your entry fee...
en: I should never have waived your entry fee...
ja: あなたの参加費を免除するんじゃなかったわ……

key: RINGMASTER: ...This is probably for the best.
en: RINGMASTER: ...This is probably for the best.
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ……まあ、これが一番よかったのかもね。

key: Mystery Participant was a silly title anyway.
en: Mystery Participant was a silly title anyway.
ja: 「なぞの参加者」なんて、そもそも安っぽい名前だったし。

key: Next time I've gotta come up with something more scrupulous...
en: Next time I've gotta come up with something more scrupulous...
ja: 次はもっと厳格な名前を考えないと……

key: Or is it less scrupulous? I always get them mixed up.
en: Or is it less scrupulous? I always get them mixed up.
ja: それとも緩い方がいいのかしら? いつもごっちゃになるのよね。

key: Like... "Enigma Entrant!"
en: Like... "Enigma Entrant!"
ja: たとえば……「エニグマ・エントラント」とか!
……ダメ?

key: CASS: So.
en: CASS: So.
ja: キャス: それでね。

key: \PN.
en: \PN.
ja: \PN。

key: Buddy.
en: Buddy.
ja: バディ。

key: Friend.
en: Friend.
ja: フレンド。

key: Pal.
en: Pal.
ja: パル。

key: I was talking to Lumi in the last round.
en: I was talking to Lumi in the last round.
ja: 前のラウンドでルミと話してたんだけど。

key: And she told me about the time when she was hiding in the glass factory.
en: And she told me about the time when she was hiding in the glass factory.
ja: あの子、ガラス工場に隠れてたときのこと、話してくれたのよ。

key: And her Glaceon was helping you out.
en: And her Glaceon was helping you out.
ja: そのときグレイシアがあんたを助けてたって。

key: You know what I'm talking about?
en: You know what I'm talking about?
ja: 何の話か分かるでしょ?

key: And she just happened to mention that during that time, you never once pet Glaceon.
en: And she just happened to mention that during that time, you never once pet Glaceon.
ja: それでね、ルミがふと言ったんだけど、その間ずっと、あんた一度もグレイシアをなでなかったんだって。

key: Once.
en: Once.
ja: 一度も。

key: Through all the time it was helping you.
en: Through all the time it was helping you.
ja: あんなに助けてもらってた、その間ずっと。

key: What's up with that.
en: What's up with that.
ja: それ、どうなってんの。

key: Forget it. There's nothing you could say in your defense anyway.
en: Forget it. There's nothing you could say in your defense anyway.
ja: もういいわ。どうせ言い訳のしようもないでしょ。

key: The crimes you've committed are already unforgivable.
en: The crimes you've committed are already unforgivable.
ja: あんたのやったことは、もう許されることじゃない。

key: All that's left is for me to enact justice upon you.
en: All that's left is for me to enact justice upon you.
ja: あとは、あたしがあんたに正義を下すだけ。

key: Right.
en: Right.
ja: その通り。

key: CASS: Whatever. I'm done here.
en: CASS: Whatever. I'm done here.
ja: キャス: もういいわ。ここでの用はすんだから。

key: The shame of what you did will live forever in the space where your heart should be.
en: The shame of what you did will live forever in the space where your heart should be.
ja: あんたがやったことの恥は、心があるべき場所にずっと居座り続けるでしょうね。

key: Hope you didn't break your F12.
en: Hope you didn't break your F12.
ja: F12キー、壊してないといいけど。

key: CASS: That's what you get.
en: CASS: That's what you get.
ja: キャス: それが報いってものよ。

key: Maybe next time don't spit on a Pokémon that was doing its best to help you.
en: Maybe next time don't spit on a Pokémon that was doing its best to help you.
ja: 今度は、精一杯助けてくれたポケモンに唾を吐くの、やめときなさいよね。

key: Now if you'll excuse me, I have an autograph to get.
en: Now if you'll excuse me, I have an autograph to get.
ja: それじゃ悪いけど、あたしはサインをもらいに行くから。

key: I promised Lumi I would get it for her if I won.
en: I promised Lumi I would get it for her if I won.
ja: 勝ったらルミのためにもらってくるって、約束したのよ。

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: じゃあね。

key: CASS: No need for a dramatic preamble; let's just go.
en: CASS: No need for a dramatic preamble; let's just go.
ja: キャス: 大げさな前置きはいらないでしょ、さっさと始めましょ。

key: Great.
en: Great.
ja: よし。

key: CASS: I don't really know what else anyone expected when they admitted the local Champion to a tournament.
en: CASS: I don't really know what else anyone expected when they admitted the local Champion to a tournament.
ja: キャス: 地元のチャンピオンを大会に参加させておいて、みんな他に何を期待してたのかしらね。

key: I didn't even want the autograph anyway, I just think Meloetta's neat.
en: I didn't even want the autograph anyway, I just think Meloetta's neat.
ja: そもそもサインなんて別に欲しくなかったし、ただメロエッタがいいなって思っただけ。

key: Well, whatever.
en: Well, whatever.
ja: まあ、どうでもいいけど。

key: MELOETTA: Lalala~
en: MELOETTA: Lalala~
ja: メロエッタ: ラララ〜

key: MELOETTA: Leelo!
en: MELOETTA: Leelo!
ja: メロエッタ: リーロ!

key: Lo lei li la~
en: Lo lei li la~
ja: ロレイリラ〜

key: Lo la li lo~
en: Lo la li lo~
ja: ロラリロ〜

key: MELOETTA: Lo!
en: MELOETTA: Lo!
ja: メロエッタ: ロ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
